newsAll.body: Head coach Dan Quinn said that Daniels (elbow) will join the team in London and practice in some form this week ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts, Zach Selby of the Commanders' official site reports.
newsAll.head: Jayden Daniels: Set to practice during Week 4

newsAll.body: Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley said Douglas (ankle) is day-to-day and could practice Wednesday, Travis Wingfield of the team's official site reports.
newsAll.head: Caleb Douglas: Day-to-day, could practice Wednesday

newsAll.body: Hall is considered week-to-week after an MRI on Monday revealed that his thigh injury isn't significant as feared, Ian Rapoport and Adam Schefter of ESPN report.
newsAll.head: Breece Hall: Viewed as week-to-week after MRI
